text: Hello I am a foster carer and I have a 5 year old boy placed with me, he only came to us recently so I dont know him that well yet which is making me even more scared. Tonight his temprature is 38.3 and when I was getting him into his pyjamas I noticed some little spots on his tummy and a couple of darker purply marks on his legs, almost like small brusies but he hasnt banged himself that I know of. I remembered reading about the glass thing so I pressed a glass on them and they DONT go away, I can still see them clear as anything through the glass. I did it twice to be sure. I dont know if I am meant to ring his social worker first or what the proceedure is for out of hours, I just want to make sure hes ok. Please tell me what I should do, I am shakeing typing this
